reply.text: That's a real cost to feel, and I'm not going to pretend it isn't. I can't see what you pay or what your gym charges, so I can't tell you whether it's worth cutting. What I can do is look at what you've actually been getting from your training. If you tell me which fee is the problem, or what you're weighing up, I'll help you work out whether you need the membership you have, or whether a lighter setup would still hit your goals.
